factors.name: advancedADASMonetization
factors.basis: Mobileye's July 23 Q2 release disclosed a high-volume Cloud-Enhanced ADAS design win with Stellantis, with gross profit per unit described as roughly equivalent to Surround ADAS and more than double current average base-ADAS profitability.

risks: Program economics are management-described and future production execution remains required.
unknowns: Program volume, exact launch models and absolute unit economics were not disclosed.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution

factors.name: guidanceAndCashExecution
factors.basis: Q2 2026 revenue was $508 million; Mobileye raised the midpoint of full-year revenue guidance by $20 million to a $1.97-$2.02 billion range and reported $210 million of operating cash flow for the first six months.

risks: A large portion of the adjusted operating-income guidance improvement was tied to an Israeli R&D incentive grant rather than underlying volume growth.
contradictions: Revenue was approximately flat year over year in Q2 even as full-year revenue guidance improved modestly and advanced-product pipeline commentary strengthened.
unknowns: Conversion timing and margin realization from advanced-product launches remain uncertain.

facts: Full-year revenue outlook was narrowed to $1.97-$2.02 billion and midpoint increased by $20 million.
Operating cash flow for the first six months was $210 million.

Mobileye disclosed a high-volume Stellantis Cloud-Enhanced ADAS design win and said gross profit per unit is roughly equivalent to Surround ADAS and more than double current average base ADAS profitability.
Adjusted operating-income guidance improvement was primarily related to an R&D incentive grant.

result: New primary-source Q2 guidance, cash-generation and advanced-ADAS monetization evidence packaged for Alpha; numeric underwriting remains Alpha-owned.
